target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test one current emerging techno/dubstep cut, one September 2026 machine-music release, two overlooked broken-form catalogue tracks, and one recent acid-breakbeat cut across their strongest lawful placements. Character change is allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT / NATIVE BOUNDARIES SEPTEMBER 2026: https://nativeboundaries.bandcamp.com/album/infected-eye-ep — all four Orlando Voorn tracks were screened. Infected Eye retained as the exact title cut; the raw electro/techno/acid/dub and driving-rhythm description is release-level, not track-specific.

CURRENT / EMERGING NATIVE BOUNDARIES MAY 2026: https://luciddistraction.bandcamp.com/album/twerk-ep — the original, VIP and remix variants were screened. Only the original Twerk was retained, using the label's exact-track sweeping-bass, dirty-vocal-chop and wonkier-production description.

RECENT CATALOGUE / FIXED RHYTHMS: https://spf-50.bandcamp.com/album/the-rush — all four tracks were screened. The Rush retained from the label's exact-track acid-breakbeat-techno description; its 2026 upcoming SPF 50 release was inspected but excluded because only release-level evidence was available.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / AMOR SATYR: https://ra.co/reviews/35519 and https://amorsatyr.bandcamp.com/track/rebola — the Transfer EP was screened. Rebola retained from Resident Advisor's exact-track description of a trance-led pattern crash-landing into baile funk passages and stuttered vocals.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / PLAID: https://ra.co/reviews/23823 and https://plaid.bandcamp.com/track/maru — the Polymer tracklist was screened. Maru retained from Resident Advisor's exact-track broken-techno, heavy-kick and shoulder-shuffling-snare description.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Bandcamp Daily's July 2026 electronic list, September 4, 2026 Essential Releases index, Planet Rhythm's September 2026 listings, Hodge's Sunlight On A Broken Column, Siu Mata & Amor Satyr's Nechung, Skee Mask catalogue, and adjacent Native Boundaries releases were screened. Hodge, Nechung, Skee Mask and other nearby identities were not promoted because their evidence was weaker than, overlapped with, or duplicated the five ranked directions.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 43 named tracks across current releases, adjacent/emerging labels and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–65 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
Remixes and alternate versions were excluded from the exact leads. No lead was promoted for recency, artist or label reputation, genre, novelty, title, BPM or technical cleverness.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, perceived pulse, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown. Release-level evidence for Infected Eye is explicitly marked and not converted into exact-track sonic fact.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Amor Satyr — Rebola: strongest exact structural-turn case, with a trance-led pattern documented as crash-landing into baile funk and stuttered vocals.
2. Lucid Distraction — Twerk: strongest current emerging exact-track case, with documented wonkier production, sweeping bass and dirty vocal chops.
3. Plaid — Maru: strongest overlooked broken-techno case, with exact heavy-kick and shoulder-shuffling-snare evidence.
4. Orlando Voorn — Infected Eye: strongest September 2026 current-release identity, but its belonging evidence remains release-level.
5. SPF 50 — The Rush: strong recent acid-breakbeat exact-track discovery, ranked below the more structurally distinctive and current leads.
